This is a GPS-guided driving tour of the Cherokee homelands. It is a two-hour tour but usually lasts longer. You will drive sixty miles through mountains and coves. All roads are paved, but some are narrow with tight curves. The tour is not appropriate for large vehicles like motorhomes. The tour is not timed. It is based on your geolocation. So stop and get out at any of our six destinations or anywhere else.The tour will wait. You will drive through town and countryside. Please respect the residents. They are your hosts. This is the voice you will hear for navigation. Except for these driving directions, you will listen to the natural voices of tribal storytellers who are sharing with you 8 classic Cherokee stories and dozens of scenes from their history.
